lines.text: MEDDIC. Sandler. SPIN. Five more. Eight named sales methodologies, one addon underneath every one of them: crm methodology.
It owns three mechanisms. Requirements: what has to be known. Checkpoints: the moment it's checked. Enforcement: block the deal, or just warn.
Three methodologies are seeded today. MEDDIC: six Requirements, three Playbook Questions. Sandler: three Requirements, two questions. SPIN: zero Requirements, playbook only, by design.

Five more aren't configured yet, but the mapping already holds. CustomerCentric Selling and Solution Selling become Requirements. The Challenger Sale and ValueSelling read as a Playbook Question or a value figure. Consultative Selling implies no fixed set at all.
Same three mechanisms, whichever methodology your team already runs. Configure it once, and Odoo holds every deal to it.
